notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Today came the first update for the game, and that's what it was changed added:
1. The game has English (menu and voice)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/91396c22c3fc0eca4330b016547ac05f80dcb5eb.jpg[/img]
2. Added workers: screws, rudder and fins
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/da35f1ad6b31d6b57c5a0c72cc710ca8769b3783.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/577095e160de1bea416a71a5dcf9aae04eb53fa9.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/4cf41e345001cce045c1d6dd6e9aa7cbe80a1652.png[/img]
3. Added new locations on two maps
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/a48ba3f96b1006d65a9dde78f22622e6747752a5.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/6798e96a323775020100eaf597f50fe5055dd44d.png[/img]
4. Changed fog, now it is processed by light, which gives realism
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/88903ea2443494fd97d6ab9e0a84b8fd23cc02ed.png[/img]
5. Also on the bridge added moving cars and locomotives with cars
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35439690/d574e8ee765f992af932bdab39382c1dc3363ada.png[/img]
